question: What external bodily element is identified as the cremation ground and why?
premises: The inner principle was identified as a cremation ground.
The skin has the nature of devouring time.
An external locus can also be called a cremation ground.
inference: Because of its time-devouring nature, the skin is identified as the cremation ground outside.
plain_english: Because of its nature of devouring time, the skin is that cremation ground on the outside.
